claim_tested: Which subunit holds the carbamoyl phosphate site
key_finding: OXTCase purified and assayed only as the intact AllF-AllG-AllH complex; KM(CP)=1.3 mM, Vmax 15.4 U/mg; KM(oxamate)=36.9 mM, Vmax 27.0 U/mg. Authors state the enzyme shows no similarity to ATCase, OTCase or YgeW transcarbamylases.
context: E. coli K-12, recombinant purified protein, in vitro
confidence: High for complex-level activity; gives no subunit-level localisation

claim_tested: Whether all three genes are required
key_finding: allFGH form an operon with allK (catabolic carbamate kinase), downstream of allECD; all three gene products needed to reconstitute OXTCase
context: E. coli K-12, anaerobic growth on allantoin
confidence: High; does not distinguish catalytic from structural roles

claim_tested: Does AllG or AllH have a carbamoyltransferase or carbamate kinase fold
key_finding: 0 of 1393 alignments match any carbamoyltransferase, carbamate kinase or amino-acid-kinase fold. AllG's only significant non-self hit is 3CLQ, an unknown-function E. faecalis protein (E=2.0e-46, 45.7% id, no ligands). AllH has no hit at E<1e-3 in PDB100 or CATH50.
confidence: High for absence of a recognisable fold; cannot exclude a novel CP site

claim_tested: Does any subunit carry a transcarbamylase CP-binding motif
key_finding: S-x-R-T-R present in PyrB (53) and ArgF/ArgI (56); absent from AllF, AllG and AllH, as are the OTCase HPxQ and ATCase HCxP motifs
confidence: High; motif absence is strong only for canonical transcarbamylases

claim_tested: Could AllF host a phosphoryl-transfer site via its succinyl-CoA ligase alpha fold
key_finding: SucD His247, the catalytic phosphohistidine, maps onto AllF Val293 (via 3DMY index 193, E=8.1e-08). AllF has lost the catalytic residue.
context: E. coli SucD AlphaFold model vs PDB 3DMY (AllF, 2.07 A)
confidence: High; alignment reproduced in both query directions

claim_tested: Does AllF retain any phosphate-binding element
key_finding: PF02629 CoA/ADP Rossmann loop invariant: G194 1.00, G197 0.96, A201 0.97, S202 0.84, G203 1.00, T204 0.93, G205 1.00, Q207 0.99. Invariant exposed H389 and K261.
context: Foldseek AFDB50 close homologs, seqId>=25%, cov>=70%

claim_tested: Which subunit has a conserved pocket suited to carbamoyl phosphate plus Mg2+
key_finding: AllH loop G160-K161-G162-P163-G164-L165-T166-P167-S168-H169-D170-D171 fully invariant (pLDDT 96.0); shell conservation 0.863 vs protein median 0.398. AllG's best pocket is 0.659 vs median 0.438, the weakest of the three.
context: AlphaFold monomer models; AllH homolog set shallowest (78 sequences)
confidence: Medium; Gly invariance can be backbone geometry; monomer analysis blind to interfaces

claim_tested: Whether AllF can be excluded from the catalytic unit
key_finding: AllF-AllG gene-fusion score 0.899; 119-150 UniProtKB entries fuse AllG PF06545 with AllF PF02629/PF00549/PF27530 in one ~1000 aa chain (99/100 sampled are 848-1023 aa). Only 1 entry fuses AllG with AllH. Phylogenetic co-occurrence 0.768-0.775 for all three pairs.
context: Bacteria-wide; verified examples A0A090ZLC6, A0A0R1K501, A0A0R1NBM8
confidence: High for the fusion itself; interface role is inference

claim_tested: Whether AllF is a succinyl-CoA ligase
key_finding: AllF carries IBA GO:0004775, GO:0004776, GO:0006099 and GO:0009361 inherited through PANTHER PTHR11117. Contradicted by Val293 at the catalytic position and by the absence of any beta subunit in allFGHK.
context: E. coli K-12 Q47208 GO record
confidence: High that these are paralog carry-over

claim_tested: Whether AllF has a motility function
key_finding: GO:0071973 bacterial-type flagellum-dependent cell motility, acts_upstream_of_or_within, the origin of the fdrA gene name
